blocker.summary: Reviewed test-only partition does not provide the production seams or shared fixtures needed to decouple B03 test suites from services/control-plane/bff/main.py while preserving production acceptance behavior.
blocker.rejection_context: PR #5749 head 6ec109a6815fcebf5012133b1721a22784d75789 was rejected by independent reviewer Codex on acceptance behavior preservation. Decoupling attempts that substituted test-local replicas, copied CORS logic, and synthetic route stubs violated acceptance invariants. Reviewer mandated: 'exercise the actual production-owned behavior through retained seams, using doubles only for external dependencies; if missing seams require files outside the six-path grant, stop for governed prerequisite/contract revision instead of duplicating implementations or widening scope.'
proof: P1 (test_bff_jwks_prewarm.py): Production _prewarm_jwks_cache previously resided in main.py:1269 (added in 71afb1668) but was deleted in c1894c3b0 (prune dead code). No production prewarm function currently exists anywhere in services/. Restoring it to a production module requires editing files outside the six-path grant.

P1 (test_auth_jwks_strict.py): Directly asserts on CORS constants (_CORS_ALLOW_HEADERS, _CORS_EXPOSE_HEADERS), environment resolution (_cors_origins_from_env), regex preview matching (_LOVABLE_PREVIEW_ORIGIN_PATTERN), and CORS middleware (_PantheonCORSMiddleware). All are defined only in services/control-plane/bff/main.py lines 230-633. No decoupled production CORS seam exists outside main.py.

P1 (test_bff_session_auth_me_contract.py): Exercises session and role authorization across 5 actual production management routes (/bff/management/persona-fleet, /bff/strategies, /bff/personas, /bff/management/human-inbox, /bff/management/evidence) residing in separate domain routers (personas.router, strategies.router, management_read_models.router). No lightweight shared test fixture or multi-router test harness exists to mount these routes in an isolated test client without importing main.py or bringing up full database dependencies.

P1 (test_bff_auth_facade.py): TestSettingsAuthIntegration exercises role and MFA enforcement on /api/v1/settings. The settings router dependency require_admin_mfa is implemented only in services/control-plane/bff/main.py:1770 (_require_admin_mfa), while core/app_factory.py only provides a no-op default. No shared production authorization guard is exported outside main.py.
